name: School
definition: A California public school record in the school master table.

name: CDS Code
definition: Unique California school identifier linking school, enrollment and SAT records.

name: School Status
definition: Operating status of a school, Active or Closed.

name: County
definition: California county in which a school is located.

name: School District
definition: District responsible for a school, with a district code and name.

name: District Type
definition: Administrative type of a district, coded and labelled (Unified, Elementary, State Special Schools and others).

name: School Type
definition: Instructional type of a school, coded and labelled (Elementary, High, Intermediate/Middle and others).

name: School Category
definition: Program category of a school, coded and labelled (Traditional, Continuation, State Special School and others).

name: School Address
definition: Address components of a school: street, city, state and ZIP code.

name: School Open Date
definition: Calendar date on which a school opened.

name: Grade Span
definition: Lowest and highest grade levels served by a school, for example K-8 or 9-12.

name: Virtual Instruction Type
definition: Degree to which a school is virtual: exclusively virtual, not virtual, or partially virtual.

name: Magnet Program
definition: Whether a school offers a magnet program.

name: School Geolocation
definition: Latitude and longitude coordinates of a school.

name: School Administrator
definition: Named administrator of a school with first name, last name and e-mail address.

name: Academic Year
definition: School year label such as 2014-2015 for enrollment and meal statistics.

name: School Enrollment
definition: Number of students enrolled at a school, reported for grades K-12 and for ages 5-17.

name: Free Meal Eligible Count
definition: Number of students eligible for free meals, reported for K-12 and ages 5-17.

name: FRPM Eligible Count
definition: Number of students eligible for free or reduced-price meals, reported for K-12 and ages 5-17.

name: Eligible Free Rate
definition: Share of enrolled students eligible for free meals, computed as free meal count divided by enrollment.

name: SAT Average Score
definition: School-average SAT score in reading, math and writing.

name: SAT Test Takers
definition: Number of students at a school who took the SAT.

name: Excellence Rate
definition: Share of SAT test takers scoring 1500 or above, computed as the count scoring 1500 or above divided by test takers.

name: Card Printing
definition: A Magic: The Gathering card printing record.

name: Card Name
definition: Printed name of a card in the primary card table.

name: Card Artist
definition: Illustrator credited on the card printing.

name: Card Rarity
definition: Rarity of the printing: common, uncommon, rare or mythic.

name: Border Colour
definition: Border colour of the printing: black, white, silver, gold or borderless.

name: Converted Mana Cost
definition: Converted mana cost (mana value) of a card.

name: EDHRec Rank
definition: EDHRec popularity rank of a card; rank 1 is the most popular.

name: Card Power
definition: Power characteristic of a creature card, possibly missing or non-numeric.

name: Card Subtypes
definition: Comma-separated subtypes of a card.

name: Content Warning Flag
definition: Flag indicating whether the printing has a content warning.

name: Story Spotlight Flag
definition: Flag indicating whether the card is a Story Spotlight card.

name: Expansion Set
definition: Expansion set that a card printing belongs to, with name, code, block and release date.

name: Set Code
definition: Short code identifying an expansion set.

name: Set Block
definition: Block that an expansion set belongs to.

name: Localized Card Printing
definition: Localized printing of a card with translated name, rules text and flavor text.

name: Card Ruling
definition: Official rules ruling text and date for a card.

name: Play Format
definition: Play format such as commander, gladiator, modern or legacy.

name: Legality Status
definition: Legality of a card in a format: Legal, Banned or Restricted.

name: Bank Customer
definition: Retail-banking customer identified by customer id.

name: Customer Segment
definition: Customer segment: SME, LAM or KAM.

name: Customer Currency
definition: Currency in which a customer pays: EUR or CZK.

name: Gas Station
definition: Gas station where card transactions occur, identified by station, chain and country.

name: Gas Station Chain
definition: Retail chain that a gas station belongs to.

name: Gas Station Country
definition: Country of a gas station as a three-letter code such as CZE or SVK.

name: Product
definition: Product purchased at a gas station, with a description.

name: Card Transaction
definition: Card transaction with date, time, customer, gas station, product, amount and price.

name: Transaction Date
definition: Calendar date on which a transaction occurred.

name: Transaction Time
definition: Clock time at which a transaction occurred.

name: Monthly Consumption
definition: Total consumption amount of a customer in a month.

name: Year-Month Key
definition: Year-month key of a monthly consumption record, stored as YYYYMM text.

name: Bank Account
definition: Bank account with opening date, statement frequency and district.

name: Statement Frequency
definition: Frequency at which account statements are issued.

name: Bank Client
definition: Bank client with sex, birth date and district of residence.

name: Client Sex
definition: Sex of a client: F or M.

name: Client Birth Date
definition: Birth date of a client.

name: District
definition: Administrative district in which clients and accounts are located.

name: Region
definition: Region of a district, such as Prague or north Bohemia.

name: District Average Salary
definition: Average salary reported for a district.

name: Loan
definition: Loan granted to an account, with amount, duration, payment and status.

name: Loan Amount
definition: Approved loan amount.

name: Loan Duration
definition: Loan duration in months.

name: Loan Status
definition: Contract status of a loan: A, B, C or D.

name: Account Transaction
definition: Account transaction with type, operation, amount and balance.

name: Transaction Type
definition: Credit or debit direction of a transaction: PRIJEM, VYBER or VYDAJ.

name: Transaction Operation
definition: Detailed operation of a transaction, such as VKLAD, VYBER or PREVOD.

name: Transaction Amount
definition: Monetary amount of an account transaction.

name: Formula 1 Driver
definition: Formula 1 driver with reference, code, name parts, birth date and nationality.

name: Driver Full Name
definition: Full name of a driver formed from forename and surname.

name: Driver Date of Birth
definition: Date of birth of a driver.

name: Driver Nationality
definition: Nationality of a driver.

name: Driver Reference
definition: Short reference identifier of a driver.

name: Formula 1 Constructor
definition: Formula 1 constructor (team).

name: Constructor Name
definition: Name of a constructor.

name: Constructor Nationality
definition: Nationality of a constructor.

name: Constructor Reference
definition: Short reference identifier of a constructor.

name: Circuit
definition: Race circuit with name, reference, location, country and coordinates.

name: Race
definition: A Formula 1 race event in a season, with name, round, date and circuit.

name: Race Result
definition: Race result row for one driver and constructor in one race.

name: Finishing Position
definition: Finishing position of a driver in a race.

name: Race Points
definition: Championship points awarded for a race result.

name: Completed Laps
definition: Number of laps completed by a driver in a race.

name: Fastest Lap
definition: Fastest lap achieved by a driver in a race, with rank and lap time.

name: Lap Time
definition: Lap time recorded for a driver on a lap, stored as milliseconds.

name: Qualifying Result
definition: Qualifying result for a driver in a race, with Q1, Q2 and Q3 times.

name: Result Status
definition: Finishing status of a result, such as Finished or Disqualified.

name: Driver Standing
definition: Driver championship standing after a race, with points, position and wins.

name: Constructor Standing
definition: Constructor championship standing after a race, with points, position and wins.

name: Club Event
definition: Student club event with name, date, type, location, notes and status.

name: Event Type
definition: Category of an event, such as Meeting, Game or Social.

name: Event Status
definition: Lifecycle status of an event: Open, Closed or Planning.

name: Club Member
definition: Student club member with name, e-mail, position, t-shirt size and major.

name: Person Full Name
definition: Full name of a member formed from first name and last name.

name: T-shirt Size
definition: T-shirt size of a member.

name: Academic Major
definition: Academic major with name, department and college.

name: Event Attendance
definition: Attendance link between an event and a member.

name: Event Budget
definition: Per-event budget category with budgeted amount, spent amount and remaining balance.

name: Expense
definition: Individual expense charged by a member against a budget category, with description, date and amount.

name: Income
definition: Income received by the club, with date, amount and source.

name: Superhero
definition: Comic-book superhero with name, full name, physical attributes and publisher.

name: Superhero Name
definition: Superhero name of a character.

name: Superhero Full Name
definition: Civilian full name of a superhero.

name: Gender
definition: Gender of a superhero: Male, Female or N/A.

name: Colour
definition: Colour value used for eye, hair and skin attributes, such as Blue, Black or Blond.

name: Race
definition: Race of a superhero, such as Human or Alien.

name: Publisher
definition: Comic publisher of a superhero, such as Marvel Comics or DC Comics.

name: Alignment
definition: Moral alignment of a superhero: Good, Bad or Neutral.

name: Height
definition: Height of a superhero in centimetres.

name: Weight
definition: Weight of a superhero in kilograms.

name: Superpower
definition: A named superpower such as Agility or Stealth.

name: Hero Superpower Link
definition: Association of a superpower with a superhero.

name: Hero Attribute
definition: A scored attribute such as Intelligence, Strength or Speed.

name: Attribute Value
definition: Numeric score of a superhero attribute.

name: Patient
definition: Thrombosis patient with sex, birth date, patient type and diagnosis.

name: Patient Sex
definition: Sex of a patient: F or M.

name: Patient Birth Date
definition: Birth date of a patient.

name: Patient Type
definition: In-patient or out-patient status of a patient.

name: Diagnosis
definition: Diagnosed disease of a patient, such as SLE.

name: Clinical Examination
definition: Clinical examination record of a patient, with date, ANA pattern, coagulation signs and thrombosis level.

name: Thrombosis Level
definition: Graded degree of thrombosis.

name: ANA Pattern
definition: Antinuclear antibody pattern such as S, P, D or N.

name: Symptom
definition: Recorded symptoms of a patient.

name: Coagulation Degree
definition: Coagulation test sign recorded as positive or negative.

name: Laboratory Test Session
definition: Laboratory test session of a patient on a date.

name: Laboratory Measurement
definition: A numeric or coded laboratory measurement in a test session.

name: GPT (ALT)
definition: ALT/GPT liver enzyme level.

name: Albumin
definition: Blood albumin level.

name: Urea Nitrogen
definition: Blood urea nitrogen level.

name: Creatinine
definition: Blood creatinine level.

name: Total Cholesterol
definition: Total cholesterol level.

name: Creatinine Phosphokinase
definition: Creatinine phosphokinase level.

name: Blood Glucose
definition: Blood glucose level.

name: Platelet Count
definition: Platelet count.

name: Immunoglobulin G
definition: Immunoglobulin G level.

name: Immunoglobulin M
definition: Immunoglobulin M / anti-cardiolipin IgM level.

name: C-Reactive Protein
definition: C-reactive protein result.

name: Anti-Scl70
definition: Anti-Scl70 autoantibody result.

name: Anti-SSB
definition: Anti-SSB autoantibody result.

name: Anti-Centromere
definition: Anti-centromere autoantibody result.

name: Patient Age
definition: Patient age derived from birth date and the current date.

name: Molecule
definition: A chemical molecule record.

name: Carcinogenicity Label
definition: Carcinogenicity label of a molecule.

name: Atom
definition: An atom within a molecule, with element symbol.

name: Chemical Element
definition: Chemical element symbol of an atom, stored in lower case.

name: Bond
definition: A bond within a molecule, with bond type.

name: Bond Type
definition: Bond order type: single, double or triple.

name: Atom-Bond Connection
definition: Connection between a bond and an atom it joins.
